description: Reopen a closed pull request; the comment, if any, is posted as it reopens, and the people following the pull request are notified. A merged pull request cannot be reopened. A pull request that is open already is left as it is: nothing is sent, the comment is not posted and changed is false. A pull request is 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL; a bare number means the working tree's repository, or repo.

comment.description: A comment to post as the pull request reopens.

pr.description: The pull request, as 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL.

repo.description: owner/name; defaults to the working tree's repository (its origin). Used for a bare number.

name: github_pr_reopen

changed.description: False when the pull request was open already and nothing was sent.

state.description: The pull request's state now: open.

title: Reopen a GitHub pull request
